question: 从店铺日销售汇总看，曜石品牌华东店铺2026年10月12日到18日每天的实付金额是多少？
sql_executed: select `stat_date`, `paid_amount` from `trd_daily_shop_sales` tds join `dim_shop` ds on tds.`shop_id` = ds.`id` join `prd_brand` pb on ds.`brand_id` = pb.`id` join `dim_region` dr on ds.`region_id` = dr.`id` where pb.`name` = '曜石' and dr.`big_region` = '华东' and tds.`stat_date` >= '2026-10-12' and tds.`stat_date` < '2026-10-19';
final_sql: select `stat_date`, `paid_amount` from `trd_daily_shop_sales` tds join `dim_shop` ds on tds.`shop_id` = ds.`id` join `prd_brand` pb on ds.`brand_id` = pb.`id` join `dim_region` dr on ds.`region_id` = dr.`id` where pb.`name` = '曜石' and dr.`big_region` = '华东' and tds.`stat_date` >= '2026-10-12' and tds.`stat_date` < '2026-10-19';
